description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping class within the LDAP DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace. It primarily verifies the creation, validation, and attribute extraction functionalities of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping, using PHPUnit testing framework. The tests cover various scenarios including valid creation from array, handling invalid input, and extracting attribute values from LDAP entries.

classes.description: Unit test class for LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping, testing creation, validation, and attribute extraction functionalities.
